invariants.text: customer_id in Customer must be a positive integer
customer_id in Order must reference an existing Customer
category_id in Product must reference an existing Category
category_id in Product must be a positive integer
product_id in Product must be a positive integer
product_id in OrderItem must reference an existing Product
product_id in OrderItem must be a positive integer
quantity in OrderItem must be a positive integer
unit_price in OrderItem must be a positive integer (in cents)
order_id in Order must be a positive integer
order_id in OrderItem must reference an existing Order
order_id in OrderItem must be a positive integer
status in Order must be one of: ['pending', 'confirmed', 'shipped', 'cancelled']
created_at in Order must be a non-null timestamp
updated_at in Order must be a non-null timestamp
order_id in Invoice must reference an existing Order
customer_id in Invoice must reference an existing Customer
invoice_number in Invoice must be a non-null string
total_amount in Invoice must be a positive integer (in cents)
created_at in Invoice must be a non-null timestamp
stock_quantity in Product must be a non-negative integer
Order.status must be 'confirmed' to create an Invoice
Order.status must be 'confirmed' to set invoice_number, total_amount, and created_at in Invoice
Order.status must be 'confirmed' implies Invoice.total_amount equals the sum of (unit_price * quantity) for all OrderItems in the Order
Order.status must be 'confirmed' implies Invoice.created_at must be after Order.created_at
Order.status must be 'confirmed' implies stock_quantity in Product must be >= (sum of quantity for all OrderItems referencing that Product)
Order.status must be 'cancelled' implies stock_quantity in Product must be restored to its pre-order value
Order.status must be 'cancelled' implies OrderItem quantities must be zero
